conventions.coordinates: scene metres (x east, z south), the origin of src/coordinates.js
conventions.outline: unclosed ring; negative shoelace sum in (x, z) = counter-clockwise seen from above with north up; the outward normal of edge (dx, dz) is (-dz, dx) / length
conventions.pavilion: cx, cz, w along u = (cos yaw, -sin yaw), d along v = (sin yaw, cos yaw), metres; yaw in radians
conventions.height: true metres above the base (the lowest terrain sample over the footprint)
conventions.roundel: wall: centre (x, z) 0.05 m proud, yM above the base, diameter D (ring), normal (nx, nz); roof: ax, az the bar direction as read from outside the longest front
conventions.exit: x, z on the ground outside the building; yaw in the Pedestrian convention (facing (-sin yaw, -cos yaw)), away from the building
